scripts.test: npm run test:components && npm run test:material-extensions && npm run test:sam-formly && npm run test:documentation && npm run test:site
scripts.lint: npm run lint:components && npm run lint:sam-formly && npm run lint:sam-material-extensions && npm run lint:sam-design-system-site && npm run lint:documentation
scripts.lint:baseline: npm run lint:baseline:components && npm run lint:baseline:sam-formly && npm run lint:baseline:sam-material-extensions && npm run lint:baseline:sam-design-system-site && npm run lint:baseline:documentation
scripts.lint:baseline:components: npm run lint:report:components && node scripts/check-lint-baseline.mjs components eslint-report-components.json
scripts.lint:baseline:sam-formly: npm run lint:report:sam-formly && node scripts/check-lint-baseline.mjs sam-formly eslint-report-sam-formly.json
scripts.lint:baseline:sam-material-extensions: npm run lint:report:sam-material-extensions && node scripts/check-lint-baseline.mjs sam-material-extensions eslint-report-sam-material-extensions.json
scripts.lint:baseline:sam-design-system-site: npm run lint:report:sam-design-system-site && node scripts/check-lint-baseline.mjs sam-design-system-site eslint-report-sam-design-system-site.json
scripts.lint:baseline:documentation: npm run lint:report:documentation && node scripts/check-lint-baseline.mjs documentation eslint-report-documentation.json
scripts.lint:baseline:bump:components: npm run lint:report:components && node scripts/check-lint-baseline.mjs --bump components eslint-report-components.json
scripts.lint:baseline:bump:sam-formly: npm run lint:report:sam-formly && node scripts/check-lint-baseline.mjs --bump sam-formly eslint-report-sam-formly.json
scripts.lint:baseline:bump:sam-material-extensio: npm run lint:report:sam-material-extensions && node scripts/check-lint-baseline.mjs --bump sam-material-extensions eslint-report-sam-material-extensions.json
scripts.lint:baseline:bump:sam-design-system-sit: npm run lint:report:sam-design-system-site && node scripts/check-lint-baseline.mjs --bump sam-design-system-site eslint-report-sam-design-system-site.json
scripts.lint:baseline:bump:documentation: npm run lint:report:documentation && node scripts/check-lint-baseline.mjs --bump documentation eslint-report-documentation.json
scripts.federalist: npm install --only=dev && npm run demo:docs && ng build --project=sam-design-system-site --configuration production --base-href=$BASEURL/ && npm run demo:stackblitzes-federalist && npm run build:docs
scripts.changelog: gren changelog --override && git add . && git commit -m "Add changelog" && git push
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && npm run release-notes && npm run changelog
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm run release-notes && npm run changelog
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm run release-notes && npm run changelog
scripts.demo:docs:formly: npx compodoc -p libs/packages/sam-formly/tsconfig.lib.json -e json -d libs/documentation/src/lib/apidoc/formly --minimal  && node ./scripts/generate-docs.ts -f formly
scripts.demo:docs: npm run demo:docs:components && npm run demo:docs:formly
scripts.build:docs: npm run build:docs:components && npm run build:docs:formly
scripts.build-storybook: npm run docs:json && ng run sam-design-system-site:build-storybook
